scope: Group 1 design record; event IDs are authoring references, not replacement TASK11 IDs or a runtime schema

authority.providerHalt: TASK11.19 at exactly 1/75; no request or resume authorized
authority.runtimeAcceptance: NOT_RUN for these design changes; current experience acceptance remains failed

conventions.stateOwner: One authoritative game state/coordinator; role contexts do not create an independent reader-only world

globalRules: Encounter/read/choose/confirm leads to actual world action and visible consequence
Confirmation may record intent; completed transfer/travel/repair/sharing requires its actual world step
Read/help/practice pauses story pace; baking preparation does not trigger the gathering/last-boat boundary
Optional earlier stories, word help, oral practice and Sol questions are never answer/count gates
Keep exact source exposure, possession, character knowledge, help, draft, selection, performance and records separate
Pause/retry preserves actual committed state; finish a pending physical transfer or visibly cancel it before a conflicting world action
New scene wording/staging derives from cited agreements; no runtime evidence inferred

Continuous walking/boat navigation stops on pause. An already-started atomic physical action settles once at its acknowledged stable boundary, then later steps pause. Hard-crash recovery cannot guess an unacknowledged transfer.
An old completed garden-chapter-3 save cannot imply participation in newly playable scenes. Preserve the old run; use an explicit compatible mapping or a separate revised adventure under R19.
